name: fertiliser
description: Schema for harmonized fertiliser data from Danish agricultural sources (GKEA, Efterafgrøder, Gødningsregnskaber)

columns.name: data_source
columns.description: Source of the fertiliser data (gkea, efterafgroeder, goedningsregnskaber, etc.)

columns.name: year
columns.description: Year of the fertiliser data (extracted from filename or folder structure)

columns.name: cvr_number
columns.description: CVR number of the agricultural company

columns.name: journal_nummer
columns.description: Journal/reference number from the source system

columns.name: data_type
columns.description: Type/category of fertiliser data (GKEA Markplan, Efterafgrøder, Gødningsregnskaber, etc.)

columns.name: data_source_file
columns.description: Name of the source file from which the data was extracted

metadata.description: Harmonized fertiliser data from multiple Danish agricultural data sources with standardized column mapping
data_sources: GKEA markplan files - detailed field fertiliser plans
Efterafgrøder files - cover crop and alternative fertiliser applications
In-depth files - detailed fertiliser account subsets (B_*, V_* files)
metadata.note: Year extraction is dynamic from filenames and folder structures. CVR numbers enable company-level analysis.
